answer_2.quote: We measure general translation quality with tokenized case-sensitive BLEU and also report the detokenized one via sacre-BLEU. We use APT, the accuracy of pronoun translation, as an approximate proxy for document-level evaluation. We adopt tokenized BLEU, differentiable average lagging (DAL), and normalized erasure (NE) to evaluate the translation quality, latency and stability.
